exclusion_rule: HealingMaps listings NOT tagged as a psychedelic/psychedelic-therapy category (GLP-1, peptide, generic wellness clinics the source also lists)
ClinicalTrials.gov records matching a search term but carrying NO psychedelic intervention (e.g. 'DMT' = disease-modifying therapy in multiple-sclerosis trials)
Studies whose indication is anesthesia/analgesia/procedural-sedation, sharing only a molecule (ketamine) with the therapeutic field
enforcement: relevance classifier (psychiatric/anesthesia_analgesia/other); anesthesia excluded from index

exclusion_rule: Trial-site rows belonging to anesthesia/analgesia studies above
enforcement: same classifier, propagated to site rows

exclusion_rule: Rows quarantined at merge: non-facility organizations, wellness residue, unidentifiable rows
enforcement: validate.py gate; quarantine.csv with written reasons
